study_metadata.title: UBP Geometric Virology v3.0 — Geometric Virome
data_sources: Published Literature (Tortorici 2020, Pinto 2020, Shi 2020, Cao 2022, Planas 2021)

variant_fitness_ranking.name: SARS-CoV-2 Alpha Spike Glycoprotein
variant_fitness_ranking.clinical_notes: N501Y enhances ACE2 binding. P681H near furin site. 50% more transmissible than WT.

variant_fitness_ranking.name: SARS-CoV-2 Beta Spike Glycoprotein
variant_fitness_ranking.clinical_notes: K417N+E484K+N501Y. Significant immune escape. Reduced neutralization by WT sera.

variant_fitness_ranking.name: SARS-CoV-2 Gamma Spike Glycoprotein
variant_fitness_ranking.clinical_notes: K417T+E484K+N501Y. Originated in Brazil. Partial immune escape.

variant_fitness_ranking.name: SARS-CoV-2 Delta Spike Glycoprotein
variant_fitness_ranking.clinical_notes: L452R+T478K+P681R. Enhanced furin cleavage. Dominated globally mid-2021.

variant_fitness_ranking.name: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron_BA1 Spike Glycoprotein
variant_fitness_ranking.clinical_notes: 32 RBD mutations. Massive immune escape. R0~15. Lower severity but unprecedented spread.

variant_fitness_ranking.name: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron_BA2 Spike Glycoprotein
variant_fitness_ranking.clinical_notes: BA.2 more transmissible than BA.1. Different spike mutations. Partial immune escape from BA.1 immunity.

variant_fitness_ranking.name: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron_BA45 Spike Glycoprotein
variant_fitness_ranking.clinical_notes: BA.4/5 add L452R. Enhanced immune escape from BA.1/2 immunity. Dominated mid-2022.

variant_fitness_ranking.name: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron_XBB Spike Glycoprotein
variant_fitness_ranking.clinical_notes: XBB.1.5 recombinant. F486P mutation enhances ACE2 binding. Dominated early 2023.

variant_fitness_ranking.name: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron_JN1 Spike Glycoprotein
variant_fitness_ranking.clinical_notes: JN.1 descended from BA.2.86. L455S mutation. Dominated late 2023/early 2024.
